issues.description: The solution implementation declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private, but the problem statement requires implementing getters for each attribute (public access). This visibility mismatch means the expected public accessor methods are not available as specified and will confuse students and break tests that expect public getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute getter methods public. Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public so all getters match the specification (public getters for every attribute). Ensure the template and solution consistently declare these getters as public.
